title: The raid on Kethra's Anvil
description: His Orks broke the Durn Prospect Fleet, stole the Ancestor Core, and took Fleet-Theyn Hrolla Vask.

title: The Nob who keeps coming back
description: He led the raid on the dig site. Every time you break him, he returns bigger.

title: Snazrik's unpaid bill
description: You broke your debt to the freebooters. They have long memories and short tempers.
